name: Crossref works: type=proceedings with event metadata
specialty: all (mostly engineering; filter medical by publisher/prefix/subject)
license_note: Crossref metadata is CC0 / facts; polite pool needs mailto or User-Agent contact. Event fields (name, location, start, end, acronym, sponsor) are depositor-supplied and optional.

name: Crossref proceedings endpoint, select=event
license_note: CC0 metadata. Cheaper payload via select.

name: Crossref journal-article 'Abstracts ... Congress' supplements (Elsevier prefix 10.1016)
license_note: CC0 metadata. No structured event field for supplements: parse event name/year/city from title.

name: Crossref journal-article 'Abstracts of the annual congress' supplements (any publisher)
license_note: CC0 metadata. Returned Eye (RCOphth 2026), Annals of Nutrition and Metabolism (ECOG), Human Gene Therapy (ESGCT).

name: Crossref works with event.name query (event-name search)
license_note: CC0 metadata. query.event-name field query works.

name: PubMed esearch: 'Congresses as Topic'[MeSH] by year
license_note: NCBI E-utilities: free, max 3 req/s without API key, 10/s with key; cite NLM. Type field set to crossref only as nearest API-JSON category; it is a PubMed API. 351 hits for 2026.

name: PubMed esearch: Title congress/symposium + abstracts, 2026
license_note: NCBI E-utilities terms. 82 hits for 2026 at test time. Note [pt]Congress and [pt]Meeting Abstract returned 0, do not use.

name: Europe PMC: PUB_TYPE conference proceedings, 2026
license_note: Europe PMC REST API free; metadata reusable, check per-article licence for full text. 425 hits for 2026 at test time.

name: Europe PMC: title 'annual congress' + abstracts, 2026
license_note: As above. Returned pubType 'conference proceedings' (e.g. ESVONC 2026, Vet Comp Oncol 24 Suppl 2).

name: Nature Careers events listing
license_note: No RSS/iCal found. Springer Nature Terms apply; scraping needs written permission. 8 upcoming events at test time. Use as discovery lead only.

name: Nature Conferences (Springer Nature)
license_note: Static site with sitemap.xml (lastmod 2026-11-05) but no feed; event detail not extracted. Seek permission or link out only.

name: Nature Conferences sitemap.xml (change detection)
license_note: Sitemaps are intended for crawlers; use lastmod for change detection only.

name: NEJM Group live-streamed events
license_note: Nuxt JS-rendered shell; data comes from a third-party (Rubicon) API we did not use. Webinars, not congresses. Low value.

name: Elsevier events
license_note: Page loaded (JSON-LD only breadcrumbs/WebSite); event list is JS-rendered and was not extracted. robots.txt allows generic crawlers.

name: Wolters Kluwer events and training
license_note: Loaded; mostly non-medical and no feed. Not extracted.

name: WHO events collection
license_note: CollectionPage JSON-LD present; WHO content CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO. Mostly WHO-run events, not third-party congresses.

name: ESMO meeting calendar
license_note: Nuxt rendered; no iCal. robots.txt Disallow empty (allowed). Society terms apply, ask permission for reuse.

name: ESMO news RSS
license_note: Valid RSS 2.0 live at test time (pubDate 2026-11-06). News, not an events feed; useful for cancellation/announcement signals.

name: Cochrane Colloquium 2026 site
license_note: Page has JSON-LD and an RSS alternate link (not extracted). cochrane.org/events returned 404.

name: Springer Link search RSS
license_note: Valid RSS but returned generic latest items, ignoring the query at test time. Low value.

name: Nature journal RSS (RDF)
license_note: RSS 1.0/RDF for personal reading; not events. Low value for Hoggy.
